description: Error vocabulary of the TeamHarness MCP server, extracted as data from plugins/teamharness/mcp/server.py @ d8332e0a. 'message' is the stable substring actually present in server.py (for f-string messages, the fixed prefix/suffix without the interpolated value); 'code' is a stable snake_case identifier; 'hint' is recovery guidance. Data only - the server does not read this file.

errors.hint: taskId must reference an existing shared/tasks/{taskId}/meta.json
projectId must reference an existing shared/projects/{projectId}/meta.json; resolve_project recovers the project from a taskId
task ids are stable anchors; delegate a different task or reuse the existing one
project ids are unique; create_project generates a fresh id

errors.message: task not found in project plan
errors.hint: the task meta must be part of the project plan (DAG/loop tasks) before plan-level operations

errors.message: task does not belong to project
errors.hint: taskId and projectId must reference the same project
result acceptance is reserved for the trusted Leader
only the Leader assigns work
only the Leader cancels tasks
only the Leader inspects submitted results

errors.hint: only the assigned worker/remote member acknowledges a task

errors.message: submit_task requires worker or remote-member role
errors.hint: only the assigned worker/remote member submits a result

errors.message: report_progress requires worker or remote-member role
errors.hint: only the assigned worker/remote member reports progress

errors.hint: the acceptance decision must reference the status the worker actually submitted
state change not in the task transition table (task-transitions.json); the response carries from/to and a SIG-MISMATCH event was emitted

the task meta carries a status outside the transition table; repair the state, do not force a transition

errors.hint: retryable; the idempotent retry (assigned + eventId) finishes the assignment

errors.hint: retryable; the task stays prepared, so a retry cannot produce a duplicate assignment
retryable; verify the assignee's Matrix membership in the task room

retryable; check the shared-storage backend (MinIO/OSS) connectivity
pass the runtime workspace containing shared/
